cases.question: Doanh thu theo thị trường
variants: Mỗi thị trường bán được bao nhiêu tiền
expected_sql: SELECT "Market" AS market, SUM("Order Item Total") AS revenue FROM dataco GROUP BY "Market" ORDER BY revenue DESC
cases.check_sql: SELECT m."Market", m.total FROM (SELECT "Market", SUM("Order Item Total") AS total FROM dataco GROUP BY "Market") AS m
cases.author: pgiahuy

cases.question: Doanh thu theo tháng
expected_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M')) AS month, SUM("Order Item Total") AS revenue FROM dataco GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
cases.author: pgiahuy

cases.question: Top 10 danh mục có doanh thu cao nhất
expected_sql: SELECT "Category Name" AS category, SUM("Order Item Total") AS revenue FROM dataco GROUP BY "Category Name" ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
cases.author: pgiahuy

cases.question: Tỷ lệ giao hàng trễ theo phương thức vận chuyển
expected_sql: SELECT "Shipping Mode" AS shipping_mode, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "Late_delivery_risk" = 1 THEN "Order Id" END) / COUNT(DISTINCT "Order Id") AS late_rate FROM dataco GROUP BY "Shipping Mode" ORDER BY late_rate DESC
cases.author: pgiahuy

cases.question: Số đơn hàng theo trạng thái giao hàng
expected_sql: SELECT "Delivery Status" AS delivery_status, COUNT(DISTINCT "Order Id") AS orders FROM dataco GROUP BY "Delivery Status" ORDER BY orders DESC
cases.author: pgiahuy

cases.question: Lợi nhuận theo phân khúc khách hàng
expected_sql: SELECT "Customer Segment" AS customer_segment, SUM("Order Profit Per Order") AS profit FROM dataco GROUP BY "Customer Segment" ORDER BY profit DESC
cases.author: pgiahuy

cases.question: 5 khu vực có tỷ lệ giao trễ cao nhất
expected_sql: SELECT "Order Region" AS order_region, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "Late_delivery_risk" = 1 THEN "Order Id" END) / COUNT(DISTINCT "Order Id") AS late_rate FROM dataco GROUP BY "Order Region" ORDER BY late_rate DESC LIMIT 5
cases.author: pgiahuy

cases.question: Số ngày giao thực tế và dự kiến theo phương thức vận chuyển
expected_sql: SELECT "Shipping Mode" AS shipping_mode, AVG("Days for shipping (real)") AS avg_real_days, AVG("Days for shipment (scheduled)") AS avg_scheduled_days FROM dataco GROUP BY "Shipping Mode" ORDER BY avg_real_days DESC
cases.author: pgiahuy

cases.question: Doanh thu từng quý năm 2017
expected_sql: SELECT quarter(strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M')) AS quarter, SUM("Order Item Total") AS revenue FROM dataco WHERE year(strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M')) = 2017 GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter
cases.author: pgiahuy

cases.question: 5 danh mục có doanh thu cao nhất ở châu Âu
expected_sql: SELECT "Category Name" AS category, SUM("Order Item Total") AS revenue FROM dataco WHERE "Market" = 'Europe' GROUP BY "Category Name" ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
cases.author: pgiahuy

cases.question: Doanh thu theo ngày giao hàng
expected_sql: SELECT CAST(strptime("shipping date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M') AS DATE) AS ship_day, SUM("Order Item Total") AS revenue FROM dataco GROUP BY ship_day ORDER BY ship_day
cases.author: pgiahuy

cases.question: Doanh thu ở thị trường châu Á
expected_sql: SELECT "Market", SUM("Order Item Total") AS revenue FROM dataco WHERE "Market" = 'Asia' GROUP BY "Market" ORDER BY revenue DESC
cases.author: pgiahuy

cases.question: Doanh thu theo tháng giảm so với cùng kỳ năm trước
expected_sql: SELECT month(strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M')) AS month, SUM(CASE WHEN year(strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M')) = (SELECT max(year(strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M'))) FROM dataco) THEN "Order Item Total" END) AS revenue_this_year, SUM(CASE WHEN year(strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M')) = (SELECT max(year(strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M'))) FROM dataco) - 1 THEN "Order Item Total" END) AS revenue_last_year FROM dataco GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
cases.author: pgiahuy

cases.question: Doanh thu theo quý của từng thị trường
expected_sql: SELECT date_trunc('quarter', strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M')) AS quarter, "Market" AS market, SUM("Order Item Total") AS revenue FROM dataco GROUP BY quarter, market ORDER BY quarter
cases.author: pgiahuy

cases.question: Tại sao doanh thu quý 3 năm 2017 giảm
variants: tai sao doanh thu quy 3 nam 2017 giam
Doanh thu quý 3/2017 giảm vì sao
expected_sql: SELECT date_trunc('quarter', strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M')) AS quarter, SUM(CAST("Order Item Total" AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS revenue FROM dataco WHERE year(strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M')) = 2017 AND quarter(strptime("order date (DateOrders)", '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M')) IN (2, 3) GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter
cases.author: nlminuong

cases.question: Tại sao doanh thu Europe thấp hơn LATAM

expected_sql: SELECT "Market", SUM(CAST("Order Item Total" AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS revenue FROM dataco WHERE "Market" IN ('Europe', 'LATAM') GROUP BY "Market"
cases.author: nlminuong
